definitions.discovered: Unique social posts present in collector evidence.
definitions.collectorAccepted: Technically extracted by a collector; not a human quality decision.
definitions.slackSent: Persisted only after Slack confirms the message timestamp.
definitions.manuallyApproved: A non-bot Slack user added an approval reaction.
definitions.manuallyRejected: A non-bot Slack user added a rejection reaction.
definitions.published: Passed current validation and was written to the live feed.

manualOutcomeMetrics.denominatorNote: Approval rate covers explicit decisions only; pending is not rejected. Unique means deduplicated within this decision window, not first-ever discovery.

costMetrics.note: Snapshot tokens and seven-day approvals have different windows; no cost ratio is inferred. Actual review effort is not measured by Slack decision latency.
